title: Regular-function structure rings on the big fppf site
statement: Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention] and schemes [def-pc-scheme]. On the category of schemes with the fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site], the regular-function sheaf of rings is $T\mapsto\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, with restriction along $h:T\to T^{\prime}$ given by $h^\sharp:\Gamma(T^{\prime},\mathcal O_{T^{\prime}})\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. For a scheme $U$, define the commutative structure sheaf on its big fppf slice by $(T\to U)\mapsto\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ with the same restrictions. Also regard this commutative structure sheaf as a sheaf of rings by forgetting commutativity. These are respectively the global regular-function ring sheaf, the commutative slice structure sheaf, and its underlying ring sheaf.
